text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm taking the Racer's Oath! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is here. Before it starts, Super Creek cheerfully approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I, Super Creek, pledge to spoil you a whole ton this summer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: After all, this is our first summer together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll prepare your food, clean your ears, sing you lullabies for your afternoon naps, and everything in between! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she's got more than all the bases covered.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I have one more promise to make…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll find a way to overcome my bad health this summer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: With this magnificent sky and the beautiful ocean, this change in scenery will surely help lift my spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A change in environment should have a big effect, but I don't think it's enough to solve all our problems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A clue that might lead to a solution is what occured before the Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I need to work harder to make you happy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her condition declined sharply the moment she resolved to please me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This camp is the perfect opportunity to test out that theory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if getting too worked up about being kind is the cause of her problem, then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll need to change how she thinks—and I'll use our time together at summer camp to make it happen.
